question: Does the repeat-level variability (O2.14/O2.15) reflect reproducible latent imagery STATES (a small number of modes generalizing across identities within a participant) rather than only continuous measurement variability?

representation.primary: OUTSIDE-perception-support trial residual o_{s,i,r} = delta_trial - W(W.T delta_trial); exact historical W_target; no new voxel/W/residual
representation.why_outside_primary: O2.15 showed substantially stronger training-stability associations for OUT than IN

identity_effect_removal.cv_clean: a held-out repeat's own value must NOT enter the centroid used to residualize it (leave-one-repeat-out within held-out identity)

no_global_subject_pooling: latent states modeled WITHIN subject; no cross-subject concatenation; cross-subject only via coordinate-invariant state descriptors

models.M0: ONE_CONTINUOUS_STATE (single full-cov Gaussian in frozen D=2)

dimensionality.source: frozen O2 outside-support D=2; NO PCA dimension search

state_space.per_subject_roi_fold: build D=2 outside basis from TRAINING identities/repeats only; project identity-residualized repeat residuals into it; no held-out identity in basis

generalization.design: 6 outer folds; TRAIN=10 outer-training identities, TEST=2 held-out; fit K1/K2 on TRAINING-identity repeat residuals; evaluate predictive likelihood on HELD-OUT identities' repeats (prevents state==identity)

model_spec.gmm: deterministic full-covariance Gaussian mixture in D=2
model_spec.init: deterministic fixed/exhaustive multi-start (data-quantile seeds); multiple starts ONLY to solve optimization, select MAX TRAINING likelihood; record all starts

label_switching.canonicalize: state centroid projection on first outside axis: lower->STATE0, higher->STATE1 (reproducibility only)

primary_effect.DELTA_LL: mean heldout loglik K2 - mean heldout loglik K1

complexity_penalty_control.primary_decision: HELD-OUT predictive likelihood ONLY; no criterion cherry-picking

matched_null.construction: within each identity, deterministic random angular rotation of repeat residual vectors around the identity centroid preserving each repeat norm

support_rule: TWO_STATE_STRUCTURE_SUPPORTED (ROI) iff ALL: median E_STATE>0; >=6/8 E_STATE>0; Holm reject; median raw heldout DELTA_LL>0; >=6/8 raw DELTA_LL>0

identity_split_reproducibility.deterministic_split: 5 training identities vs 5 training identities balanced simple/nat

no_tiny_cluster.invalid_if: either state <20% of training repeats (hard posterior)

repeat_position.after_assignments_frozen: P(state=1|repeat_position) over 8 positions; LOSO predict 8th from 7

state_vs_o2_15.per_M4T2_pair: same dominant state vs different (states fit WITHOUT held-out schedule ids)

cross_identity_generalization.state_validity: each state receives posterior-dominant repeats from >=3 distinct training identities; a one-identity state is NOT a cross-identity latent state

within_support_secondary.after_outside_sealed: repeat exact K1 vs K2 in frozen within-support coords; status-neutral; asks imagery-specific/outside-dominant vs globally present; no Holm expansion

continuous_alternative_control.student_t: prospectively frozen single-state multivariate Student-t (D=2) with df estimated on training via deterministic ML
continuous_alternative_control.rule: if Student-t performs >= K2, do NOT interpret K2>K1 as evidence for discrete states

upgrade_MULTIMODAL_REPEAT_GEOMETRY_to_LA: 5 state separation generalizes across identity subsets

program_status.LATENT_IMAGERY_TWO_STATE_STRUCTURE_SUPPO: both primary ROIs satisfy full discrete-state rule
program_status.REPEAT_GEOMETRY_MULTIMODAL_BUT_DISCRETEN: K2>Gaussian K1 but Student-t/stability controls prevent discrete interpretation

claim_boundaries.positive: repeat-level imagery residuals outside perception-derived support were better predicted by a two-mode latent model than by prospectively specified single-state alternatives, and the latent separation generalized across held-out stimulus identities, consistent with reproducible repeat-level imagery-state structure
claim_boundaries.o2_15_link_allowed: the latent-mode description accounts for part of the repeat-geometry instability previously associated with calibration failure

synthetic_controls: 2 heavy-tailed t -> Student-t not false discrete

next_gate.SUPPORTED: X2.1 STATE-CONDITIONAL IMAGERY TRANSFORMATION INVARIANTS (does the X1 transformation law change between the two modes; T_{s,state}=U_{s,state} Lambda_state V_s^T; no causal transitions)
next_gate.MULTIMODAL_UNRESOLVED: X2.1 CONTINUOUS LATENT RELIABILITY MANIFOLD (do NOT force clustering)
next_gate.negative: seal negative; do NOT search K=4,5,6 or alternate clustering on the same cohort
